verses.text: Then I saw when the Lamb broke one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, 'Come.'
verses.textZh: 我看見羔羊揭開七印中第一印的時候，就聽見四活物中的一個活物，聲音如雷，說：你來！

verses.text: I looked, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.
verses.textZh: 我就觀看，見有一匹白馬；騎在馬上的，拿著弓，並有冠冕賜給他。他便出來，勝了又要勝。

verses.text: When He broke the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, 'Come.'
verses.textZh: 揭開第二印的時候，我聽見第二個活物說：你來。

verses.text: And another, a red horse, went out; and to him who sat on it, it was granted to take peace from the earth, and that [men] would slay one another; and a great sword was given to him.
verses.textZh: 就另有一匹馬出來，是紅的，有權柄給了那騎馬的，可以從地上奪去太平，使人彼此相殺；又有一把大刀賜給他。

verses.text: When He broke the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, 'Come.' I looked, and behold, a black horse; and he who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.textZh: 揭開第三印的時候，我聽見第三個活物說：你來！我就觀看，見有一匹黑馬；騎在馬上的，手裡拿著天平。

verses.text: And I heard [something] like a voice in the center of the four living creatures saying, 'A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius; and do not damage the oil and the wine.'
verses.textZh: 我聽見在四活物中似乎有聲音說：一錢銀子買一升麥子，一錢銀子買三升大麥；油和酒不可糟蹋。

verses.text: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, 'Come.'
verses.textZh: 揭開第四印的時候，我聽見第四個活物說：你來！

verses.text: I looked, and behold, an ashen horse; and he who sat on it had the name Death; and Hades was following with him. Authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with pestilence and by the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.textZh: 我就觀看，見有一匹灰色馬；騎在馬上的，名字叫作死，陰府也隨著他；有權柄賜給他們，可以用刀劍、饑荒、瘟疫（或作：死亡）、野獸，殺害地上四分之一的人。

verses.text: When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God, and because of the testimony which they had maintained;
verses.textZh: 揭開第五印的時候，我看見在祭壇底下，有為神的道、並為作見證被殺之人的靈魂，

verses.text: and they cried out with a loud voice, saying, 'How long, O Lord, holy and true, will You refrain from judging and avenging our blood on those who dwell on the earth?'
verses.textZh: 大聲喊著說：聖潔真實的主阿，你不審判住在地上的人，給我們伸流血的冤，要等到幾時呢？

verses.text: And there was given to each of them a white robe; and they were told that they should rest for a little while longer, until [the number of] their fellow servants and their brethren who were to be killed even as they had been, would be completed also.
verses.textZh: 於是有白衣賜給他們各人；又有話對他們說，還要安息片時，等著一同作僕人的和他們的弟兄也像他們被殺，滿足了數目。

verses.text: I looked when He broke the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth [made] of hair, and the whole moon became like blood;
verses.textZh: 揭開第六印的時候，我又看見地大震動，日頭變黑像毛布，滿月變紅像血，

verses.text: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth, as a fig tree casts its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.
verses.textZh: 天上的星辰墜落於地，如同無花果樹被大風搖動，落下未熟的果子一樣。

verses.text: The sky was split apart like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.textZh: 天就挪移，好像書卷被捲起來；山嶺海島都被挪移離開本位。

verses.text: Then the kings of the earth and the great men and the commanders and the rich and the strong and every slave and free man hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains;
verses.textZh: 地上的君王、臣宰、將軍、富戶、壯士，和一切為奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和巖石穴裡，

verses.text: and they said to the mountains and to the rocks, 'Fall on us and hide us from the presence of Him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb;
verses.textZh: 向山和巖石說：倒在我們身上罷！把我們藏起來，躲避坐寶座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；

verses.text: for the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?'
verses.textZh: 因為他們忿怒的大日到了，誰能站得住呢？
